_comment: Rules for install_parity.py, which compares the pins in a release Dockerfile
with the pin block in the matching bare-metal setup.sh.
Most pins share a name on both sides (18 of them for the primus pair), so
name matching is the default and this file only carries the exceptions:
renames, script-internal variables that are not pins at all, and the
divergences the install READMEs document as deliberate.
A parity checker that cannot tell deliberate divergence from drift is worse
than none, because it trains people to ignore it.

primus.TORCHVISION_VERSION: Dockerfile floats `torchvision==0.27`; the script pins the full nightly so a bare-metal install is reproducible.
primus.TORCHAUDIO_VERSION: Dockerfile floats `torchaudio==2.11.0`; the script pins the full nightly.
primus.APEX_VERSION: Dockerfile builds APEX unpinned; the script pins the wheel it was built against.
primus.FLYDSL_VERSION: Primus-Turbo is installed with --no-deps bare-metal, so flydsl is pinned explicitly.
primus.TE_COMMIT: Source-build fallback for the TE wheel; the Dockerfile only ever uses the wheel.

jax.TE_SOURCE_COMMIT: Optional `te_source` stage, which has no Dockerfile counterpart.
jax.RCCL_COMMIT: Dockerfile checks RCCL out inline in jax_base; the script pins the same commit as a variable.
jax.JAX_ROCM_VERSION: Dockerfile derives the plugin version from JAX_VERSION; the script pins it so the pjrt/plugin pair cannot skew.

_dockerfile_only_packages_why: Packages the release Dockerfile pins that the bare-metal script legitimately
never names. Anything not listed here is reported as drift, because a changed
package set moves no shared variable and so nothing else catches it: v26.7 grew
Transformer Engine from two distributions to three and renamed the JAX plugin
pair, and the first release run shipped scripts missing both.
Per-arch wheels (*-gfx942, *-gfx950) are excluded automatically -- the script
builds those names from PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH at run time.

primus.msgpack: a sed on pip's own vendored dependency list (src/pip/_vendor/vendor.txt) in the pip_builder stage, not a package installed into the training environment; bare metal uses stock pip

jax.torch: installed by the MaxDiffusion stage, which the bare-metal script skips
jax.transformers: pinned by the jax_training stage; bare metal takes it from Primus' requirements-jax.txt

inline_pins._comment: Pins the Dockerfiles express inside RUN lines rather than as ARG. Only four exist in Dockerfile.primus-v26.6 against 66 ARG/ENV declarations, so an explicit list beats a general parser.
